vetSays.line: 🛡️ Linh, Kelsey, Sergio, Mireille and Pasquale met them at the door — 5 put down. Linh, Kelsey, Sergio, Mireille, Pasquale are hurt.
🛡️ Kelsey, Mireille, Pasquale and Somchai met them at the door — 4 put down. Kelsey, Mireille, Pasquale, Somchai are hurt.
🛡️ Linh, Kelsey and Mireille met them at the door — 3 put down. Linh, Kelsey, Mireille are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Pavel just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Pasquale just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Mireille, Pasquale and Ava met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 barely walked away. Mireille, Pasquale are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ava just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Linh, Kelsey, Somchai and Sofia met them at the door — 4 put down. Linh, Kelsey, Somchai, Sofia are hurt.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Linh just put down The Audit... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Petra just put down Big Ugly... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
The Scarred Big Big wears Petra's face. The face is too symmetrical. The eyes don't track you — they don't track anything.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
The Scarred Big Big falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Scarred Big Big!
Blooded — the village knows where the Producers bleed. (Strikes hit 1.5× as hard; their blows land at 0.75× strength.)
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Wei taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
The fire burns low. 2 new lines in the journal tonight — loudest: European Elder — named and noted.
You start in on European Elder, Ghost Pipe, Cow Parsley too — and they grin. "Old news, friend. Mireille showed us that one." Still: you carried it home. That's the job.
